cabin_note: Windows and door outlines, from b757-200_uv_test.png.
source: GeoFS community 757-200 GXD04N_126645_238: the 11 parts LiverySelector re-textures (body, rudder, doors, gear doors, wing doors, reversers), material 'texture' (texture.png)
method: Every textured triangle of the model rasterized into UV space and labelled from its part name, 3D position and facing (tools/uv_regions.py). UV v runs down the image (row = v * height), verified against the helmet/pilot island.

geom_axes.G: height: 0 = lowest point .. 255 = top of the fin

in_sim: UNVERIFIED IN-SIM: derived from the model files, not yet checked with the region-ID sheet in GeoFS.

regions.name: fuselage_l
regions.where: left (port) fuselage side, drawn as a side profile, nose at left
regions.notes: Upper band of the texture. Text reads normally.

regions.name: fuselage_r
regions.where: right (starboard) fuselage side, side profile, nose at left
regions.notes: Lower band. The island is mirrored: text must be flipped horizontally to read right in-sim (Eric's shipped liveries already do this).

regions.name: nose_cone
regions.notes: Geometric cut 1.9 m from the tip.

regions.name: tail_cone
regions.where: tail cone aft of the fin, both sides
regions.notes: Geometric cut 3.5 m from the tail.

regions.name: wing_fairing
regions.where: wing-to-body fairing / belly under the wing root

regions.name: fin_r
regions.where: vertical fin, right side (mirrored like fuselage_r)

regions.name: engines
regions.where: engine nacelles and thrust reversers, both engines share
regions.notes: This is the right half of the old 'N1/N2' box (the N2 half).

regions.name: winglets
regions.notes: The left half of the old 'N1/N2' box (N1) is the winglets, not an engine.

regions.name: wing_strip
regions.where: the few wing faces that use this texture (a thin strip)
regions.notes: Most of the wing is untextured grey in this model; only this strip takes paint.

regions.name: hstab_strip
regions.where: the few h-stab faces that use this texture (a thin strip)

regions.name: doors
regions.where: nose gear, main gear and wing gear doors (tiny)
